definitions.gloss: thoroughly, completely, to the bitter end
definitions.explanation: Doing something all the way through without stopping or compromising; pursuing to the extreme.

examples.japanese: とことん⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}おう→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
とことん⟦{追|お}い{詰|つ}められた→追い詰める：14311_oitsumeru⟧。
examples.english: I was driven into a corner completely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧とことん⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧。
examples.english: We are thoroughly committed to quality.

examples.japanese: とことん⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦みよう→てみる：30510_temiru⟧。
examples.english: Let's go all the way with this.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: Possibly derived from the sound of footsteps going on endlessly (⟦とことこ→とことこ：30284_tokotoko⟧), with intensification.

NUANCE: Implies determination and persistence. Can be:
- Positive: thorough effort, dedication
- Negative: being pushed to extremes, cornered

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- とことん⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}う→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧ (discuss thoroughly)
- とことん⟦{追|お}い{詰|つ}める→追い詰める：14311_oitsumeru⟧ (corner completely)
- とことん⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧ (be particular about to the extreme)
- とことん⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧ (do thoroughly)
- とことん⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}う→付き合う：02291_tsukiau⟧ (see it through together)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{徹底的|てっていてき}→徹底的：06827_tetteiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (thoroughly) - more formal
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ (until the end) - neutral
- とことん⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ (to the very limit) - intensified form

REGISTER: Slightly casual, conversational. More colloquial than ⟦{徹底的|てっていてき}→徹底的：06827_tetteiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.
